Compatibility Mode selects the most widely compatible rendering options. These are likely to be slower than the default options, so are only recommended if you're having trouble starting the game.

Choose 'Save settings and play' to use compatibility mode's settings - both now and when you launch the game normally in future. Or you can view and edit these options first.

If you don't want to change anything, just quit and launch the game normally.

key:
The most lethal contractors in the galaxy. Step into their pulsing sensor range and they will instantly detect you, teleport to you, and kill you in the same move. Shields don't help, their blade is already in you when they glitch. Good luck.

Crashing a Predator disables their sensor and teleporter. Subverting them does something else.
english:
The most lethal contractors in the galaxy. Step into their pulsing sensor range and they will instantly detect you, teleport to you, and kill you in the same move. Shields don't help, their blade is already in you when they glitch. Good luck.

Crashing a Predator disables their sensor and teleporter. Subverting them does something else.

Najbardziej zabójczy najemnicy w galaktyce. Wejdź w pulsujący zasięg ich czujnika, a natychmiast cię wykryją, teleportują się do ciebie i zabiją jednym ruchem. Tarcze nie pomogą — ostrze już w tobie tkwi, gdy kończą glitch. Powodzenia.

Zawieszenie Drapieżnika wyłącza jego czujnik i teleporter. Przeprogramowanie robi coś innego.

key:
A contractor with specialised sensors that track your exact location on the ship at any range. They will hunt you relentlessly, their reactions are instantaneous, and their high velocity rifle is virtually impossible to dodge. Watch for the red tracks leading to you.

Crashing a Tracker disables their sensors.
english:
A contractor with specialised sensors that track your exact location on the ship at any range. They will hunt you relentlessly, their reactions are instantaneous, and their high velocity rifle is virtually impossible to dodge. Watch for the red tracks leading to you.

Crashing a Tracker disables their sensors.

Najemnik ze specjalnymi czujnikami, które z każdej odległości śledzą twoje dokładne położenie na statku. Poluje bezlitośnie, reaguje natychmiast, a przed jego szybkim karabinem praktycznie nie da się uskoczyć. Uważaj na czerwone ślady prowadzące do ciebie.

Zawieszenie Tropiciela wyłącza jego czujniki.

key:
A contractor who moves through the ship installing jamming devices that prevent any of your gadgets from working while you're inside their square of effect. The field also scrambles incoming teleportation, so glitching into it is not advised. The jammers can be destroyed up close if you can get to them.

Crashing a Jammer prevents them from placing any more jamming devices. Subverting them does something else.

A contractor who moves through the ship installing jamming devices that prevent any of your gadgets from working while you're inside their square of effect. Zawieszenie Zagłuszacza nie pozwala mu stawiać kolejnych zagłuszaczy. Przeprogramowanie robi coś innego.

key: You've been better before because you're bad now, or you're better now because you were bad before?
english: You've been better before because you're bad now, or you're better now because you were bad before?
polish: Bywało lepiej, bo teraz jest źle, czy teraz jest lepiej, bo przedtem było źle?

key: I don't have the bandwidth to process that.
english: I don't have the bandwidth to process that.
polish: Nie mam mocy przerobowych, żeby to ogarnąć.

key: Sorry to hear that. What do you need?
english: Sorry to hear that. What do you need?

key: So you quit Foundry? How does it feel?
english: So you quit Foundry? How does it feel?
polish: Więc Foundry to już przeszłość? Jak się z tym czujesz?

key: What are you up to these days?
english: What are you up to these days?

key: You ever hear of the Sleepers?
english: You ever hear of the Sleepers?

key: I have, but let's explain it for anyone eavesdropping.
english: I have, but let's explain it for anyone eavesdropping.
polish: Mówią, ale wyjaśnijmy to dla tych, co podsłuchują.

key: Fiasco's why you haven't heard of the Sleepers. It's a long story.
english: Fiasco's why you haven't heard of the Sleepers. It's a long story.
polish: To przez Fiasco nic ci nie mówią. Długa historia.

key: Fiasco's why they're gone. It's a long story.
english: Fiasco's why they're gone. It's a long story.
polish: To przez Fiasco już ich nie ma. Długa historia.

key: They were a massive force, came out of the cold speaking a language no-one knew, with tech we'd never seen.
english: They were a massive force, came out of the cold speaking a language no-one knew, with tech we'd never seen.
polish: To była potężna siła. Przyszli z zimnej pustki, mówili językiem, którego nikt nie znał, i mieli technologię, jakiej nigdy nie widzieliśmy.

key: People thought they were gonna take the whole Drift.
english: People thought they were gonna take the whole Drift.
polish: Ludzie myśleli, że zajmą cały Dryf.

key: Then, somewhere in the fight, they killed the wrong person.
english: Then, somewhere in the fight, they killed the wrong person.
polish: A potem, gdzieś w trakcie walk, zabili niewłaściwą osobę.

key: I never heard who, and she ain't saying, but someone Fiasco cared about.
english: I never heard who, and she ain't saying, but someone Fiasco cared about.
polish: Kogo — tego nie wiem, a ona nie mówi, ale kogoś, na kim Fiasco zależało.

key: And she just took. Them. Apart. Over YEARS.
english: And she just took. Them. Apart. Over YEARS.
polish: I po prostu ich. Rozebrała. Na części. Przez LATA.

key: Some of it was direct - she killed their commander within two hours, leaked their cyphers, and personally stole like a third of their fleet.
english: Some of it was direct - she killed their commander within two hours, leaked their cyphers, and personally stole like a third of their fleet.
polish: Część wprost: w dwie godziny zabiła ich dowódcę, ujawniła ich szyfry i osobiście ukradła jakąś jedną trzecią floty.

key: But some of it - it had to be her, but you can't see how.
english: But some of it - it had to be her, but you can't see how.
polish: Ale część… to musiała być ona, tylko nie widać jak.

key: Sovereign showed up, at the worst possible time. She doesn't control Sovereign! They don't even like her!
english: Sovereign showed up, at the worst possible time. She doesn't control Sovereign! They don't even like her!
polish: Sovereign zjawiło się w najgorszym możliwym momencie. Ona nie kontroluje Sovereign! Oni jej nawet nie lubią!

key: The Sleepers lost the last of their fleet in an electrical storm. Does she control STORMS? No-one controls storms, right?
english: The Sleepers lost the last of their fleet in an electrical storm. Does she control STORMS? No-one controls storms, right?
polish: Śpiący stracili resztę floty w burzy elektrycznej. Czy ona kontroluje BURZE? Nikt nie kontroluje burz, prawda?

key: Anyway, that's how I heard of her. Then one day this white haired woman walks into my local looking like she could kill everyone in the room.
english: Anyway, that's how I heard of her. Then one day this white haired woman walks into my local looking like she could kill everyone in the room.
polish: W każdym razie stąd ją znam. A potem pewnego dnia do mojej knajpy wchodzi ta siwowłosa kobieta i wygląda, jakby mogła zabić wszystkich na sali.

key: Now she's got me stealing space stations.
english: Now she's got me stealing space stations.
polish: A teraz kradnę dla niej stacje kosmiczne.

key: You know, betraying my family, starting a revolution, drinking.
english: You know, betraying my family, starting a revolution, drinking.
polish: Wiesz, zdradzam rodzinę, wszczynam rewolucję, piję.

key: Yeah, you stole a station! How do you steal a station?
english: Yeah, you stole a station! How do you steal a station?
polish: No właśnie, ukradliście stację! Jak się kradnie stację?

key: Well, you've got two problems: its missile systems can beat any ship, and the interior controls are softlocked to the owner.
english: Well, you've got two problems: its missile systems can beat any ship, and the interior controls are softlocked to the owner.
polish: No więc masz dwa problemy: jej systemy rakietowe pokonają każdy statek, a sterowanie wewnątrz jest programowo zablokowane na właściciela.

key: So you need a ship with long range EM siege systems to crash the whole station from the outside, but even crashed it'll still rip that ship to shreds.
english: So you need a ship with long range EM siege systems to crash the whole station from the outside, but even crashed it'll still rip that ship to shreds.
polish: Potrzebujesz więc statku z dalekosiężnymi systemami oblężniczymi EM, żeby zawiesić całą stację z zewnątrz, ale nawet zawieszona rozerwie ten statek na strzępy.

key: So you also need someone on the inside - in this case me. While the controls are down you can hardwire them to work for you when they reboot.
english: So you also need someone on the inside - in this case me. While the controls are down you can hardwire them to work for you when they reboot.
polish: Potrzebujesz też kogoś w środku — w tym przypadku mnie. Póki sterowanie leży, można je tak przepiąć, żeby po restarcie pracowało dla ciebie.

key: Or did you mean, like, conceptually?
english: Or did you mean, like, conceptually?
polish: A może pytanie było, tak jakby, koncepcyjne?

key: Oh. Well, you reach a point where people's suffering outweighs their loyalty, then you give them a way out.
english: Oh. Well, you reach a point where people's suffering outweighs their loyalty, then you give them a way out.
polish: Aha. No więc dochodzi się do punktu, w którym cierpienie ludzi przeważa nad ich lojalnością, i wtedy daje się im wyjście.

key: But the way out has to have EM siege systems.
english: But the way out has to have EM siege systems.
polish: Tyle że to wyjście musi mieć systemy oblężnicze EM.

key: Good, actually. Not long enough to miss it yet, I guess, but it's like a lot of angry voices in my head finally shut up.
english: Good, actually. Not long enough to miss it yet, I guess, but it's like a lot of angry voices in my head finally shut up.
polish: Dobrze, serio. Chyba za krótko, żeby już tęsknić, ale to tak, jakby w głowie wreszcie ucichło mnóstwo wściekłych głosów.

key: How did Foundry end up here?
english: How did Foundry end up here?

key: I hear they're not wild about Sovereign muscling in.
english: I hear they're not wild about Sovereign muscling in.
polish: Podobno nie są zachwyceni, że Sovereign się tu wpycha.

key: They're extremely engineers. Leave a thousand drillers, shipbuilders and technicians on their own for 43 years and you get a society built on solder and rivets.
english: They're extremely engineers. Leave a thousand drillers, shipbuilders and technicians on their own for 43 years and you get a society built on solder and rivets.
polish: Są inżynierami do szpiku kości. Zostaw tysiąc wiertaczy, stoczniowców i techników samych sobie na 43 lata, a dostaniesz społeczeństwo zbudowane na lutowiu i nitach.

key: Every social problem has a tech solution, and when that doesn't solve it, they argue about what's wrong with the tech.
english: Every social problem has a tech solution, and when that doesn't solve it, they argue about what's wrong with the tech.
polish: Każdy problem społeczny ma rozwiązanie techniczne, a kiedy ono nie działa, kłócą się, co jest nie tak z techniką.

key: But, they're my family. My extremely smart, extremely stupid, loudly bickering family.
english: But, they're my family. My extremely smart, extremely stupid, loudly bickering family.
polish: Ale to moja rodzina. Moja niesamowicie mądra, niesamowicie głupia, głośno kłócąca się rodzina.

key: Glad to be out, but I bear them no malice.
english: Glad to be out, but I bear them no malice.
polish: Dobrze, że to za mną, ale nie mam do nich żalu.

key: They were a Sovereign mining expedition, sent here decades ago to test the waters and set up a station if the acid was good.
english: They were a Sovereign mining expedition, sent here decades ago to test the waters and set up a station if the acid was good.
polish: To była górnicza wyprawa Sovereign, wysłana tu dekady temu na zwiad, żeby postawić stację, jeśli kwas okaże się dobry.

key: It was, but it also bricked their long range drive, so they were stuck. Sovereign sent no help, so they set up shop.
english: It was, but it also bricked their long range drive, so they were stuck. Sovereign sent no help, so they set up shop.
polish: Okazał się dobry, ale przy tym uwalił im napęd dalekiego zasięgu, więc utknęli. Sovereign nie przysłało pomocy, więc się tu urządzili.

key: Just kept building, for 43 years. Catching asteroids as they flew by, then carving new homes into them.
english: Just kept building, for 43 years. Catching asteroids as they flew by, then carving new homes into them.
polish: Budowali i budowali, przez 43 lata. Łapali przelatujące asteroidy i drążyli w nich nowe domy.

key: They built every station in the Drift, even the ones they've lost now.
english: They built every station in the Drift, even the ones they've lost now.
polish: Zbudowali każdą stację w Dryfie, nawet te, które już stracili.

key: Oh ho, no. They. Are. Livid.
english: Oh ho, no. They. Are. Livid.

key: Sovereign basically left them to die, and they survived by making this acid cloud a civilization.
english: Sovereign basically left them to die, and they survived by making this acid cloud a civilization.
polish: Sovereign w zasadzie zostawiło ich na śmierć, a oni przetrwali, zamieniając tę kwasową chmurę w cywilizację.

key: Now Sovereign's realised how valuable it is and they're coming for it.
english: Now Sovereign's realised how valuable it is and they're coming for it.
polish: Teraz Sovereign zrozumiało, ile jest warta, i przychodzi po nią.

key: Foundry spent the last 43 years building space stations. Sovereign spent it inventing weapons. It's gonna get ugly.
english: Foundry spent the last 43 years building space stations. Sovereign spent it inventing weapons. It's gonna get ugly.
polish: Foundry przez ostatnie 43 lata budowało stacje kosmiczne. Sovereign przez ten czas wymyślało broń. Zrobi się paskudnie.

key: Thanks! I can see all the alternate realities my dead clones would have lived!
english: Thanks! I can see all the alternate realities my dead clones would have lived!
polish: Dzięki! Widzę wszystkie alternatywne rzeczywistości, w których żyłyby moje martwe klony!

key: Is this like an 'I'm a new person every year' thing or are there literally 59 other yous?
english: Is this like an 'I'm a new person every year' thing or are there literally 59 other yous?
polish: To w stylu „co roku jestem nowym człowiekiem”, czy dosłownie istnieje 59 innych ciebie?

key: There were 59 other mes but they're all dead now.
english: There were 59 other mes but they're all dead now.
polish: Było 59 innych mnie, ale wszystkie już nie żyją.

key: OK you might need to spell this out for me a bit.
english: OK you might need to spell this out for me a bit.
polish: Dobra, chyba trzeba mi to trochę rozrysować.

key: Thanks! I didn't murder them, but I bet I could have, so I'll take it.
english: Thanks! I didn't murder them, but I bet I could have, so I'll take it.
polish: Dzięki! Nie zamordowałam ich, ale założę się, że dałabym radę, więc przyjmuję.

key: They used teleporters to kill themselves and create each other, and ultimately me.
english: They used teleporters to kill themselves and create each other, and ultimately me.
polish: Używały teleporterów, żeby się zabijać i tworzyć nawzajem, aż w końcu stworzyły mnie.

key: It's a Glitcher tradition: every time you teleport you're technically killing yourself and creating a replica, so we change our names to remember what number we are.
english: It's a Glitcher tradition: every time you teleport you're technically killing yourself and creating a replica, so we change our names to remember what number we are.
polish: To tradycja Glitchers: przy każdej teleportacji technicznie zabijasz siebie i tworzysz replikę, więc zmieniamy imiona, żeby pamiętać, którym numerem jesteśmy.

key: How do you know the real you didn't die the first time you teleported?
english: How do you know the real you didn't die the first time you teleported?
polish: Skąd wiesz, że prawdziwa ty nie zginęła przy pierwszej teleportacji?

key: Not really! You're not a lump of flesh, you're a pattern. The pattern survives, the fleshlump gets fried.
english: Not really! You're not a lump of flesh, you're a pattern. The pattern survives, the fleshlump gets fried.
polish: Nie do końca! Nie jesteś kawałkiem mięsa, tylko wzorem. Wzór przeżywa, a kawałek mięsa się smaży.

key: Yeah but really really fast, it doesn't hurt.
english: Yeah but really really fast, it doesn't hurt.
polish: No, ale bardzo, bardzo szybko, nie boli.

key: It happens to every part of your body simultaneously, so your brain dies before it can receive any pain signals from the other parts.
english: It happens to every part of your body simultaneously, so your brain dies before it can receive any pain signals from the other parts.
polish: Dzieje się to jednocześnie z każdą częścią ciała, więc mózg umiera, zanim dotrą do niego jakiekolwiek sygnały bólu z reszty.

key: 59 of me have, but you're right, I didn't have time to interview them afterwards.
english: 59 of me have, but you're right, I didn't have time to interview them afterwards.
polish: 59 mnie doświadczyło, ale masz rację, nie miałam czasu przeprowadzić z nimi wywiadu po fakcie.

key: Oh that whole situation, that body and brain and all, that did die.
english: Oh that whole situation, that body and brain and all, that did die.
polish: A, cała tamta sytuacja, to ciało, mózg i reszta — to faktycznie zginęło.

key: She knew that when she pressed the button. We just don't consider that to be a person.
english: She knew that when she pressed the button. We just don't consider that to be a person.
polish: Ona wiedziała o tym, naciskając przycisk. Po prostu nie uważamy tego za osobę.

key: The person is the pattern, and the pattern survives.
english: The person is the pattern, and the pattern survives.
polish: Osoba to wzór, a wzór przeżywa.

key: What if the teleporter broke and didn't destroy the original?
english: What if the teleporter broke and didn't destroy the original?
polish: A jeśli teleporter się zepsuje i nie zniszczy oryginału?

key: Right, no, I mean would you have two people then? Isn't it wrong to kill one of them?
english: Right, no, I mean would you have two people then? Isn't it wrong to kill one of them?
polish: No tak, ale chodzi mi o to, czy byłyby wtedy dwie osoby? Czy zabicie jednej z nich nie byłoby złe?

key: Not straight away. The person is the pattern, so while the pattern's the same you've just got two copies of one person.
english: Not straight away. The person is the pattern, so while the pattern's the same you've just got two copies of one person.
polish: Nie od razu. Osoba to wzór, więc dopóki wzór jest ten sam, masz po prostu dwie kopie jednej osoby.

key: How long do you have to wait before they become two people?
english: How long do you have to wait before they become two people?
polish: Ile trzeba czekać, żeby stały się dwiema osobami?

key: Don't they both count as people just by having the potential to go off and live their own lives?
english: Don't they both count as people just by having the potential to go off and live their own lives?
polish: Czy obie nie liczą się jako osoby już przez to, że mogą odejść i żyć własnym życiem?

key: Potential's not a person. If I had that teleporter I'd have the potential to make infinite mes, but it's not wrong to throw that potential away.
english: Potential's not a person. If I had that teleporter I'd have the potential to make infinite mes, but it's not wrong to throw that potential away.
polish: Potencjał to nie osoba. Gdybym miała taki teleporter, mogłabym zrobić nieskończenie wiele mnie, ale zmarnowanie tego potencjału nie jest złe.

key: It's a sliding scale. At first it's one pattern in two places. As they diverge, the patterns become more different and more worthy of consideration as separate people.
english: It's a sliding scale. At first it's one pattern in two places. As they diverge, the patterns become more different and more worthy of consideration as separate people.
polish: To płynna skala. Najpierw to jeden wzór w dwóch miejscach. Gdy zaczynają się rozchodzić, wzory coraz bardziej się różnią i coraz bardziej zasługują na miano osobnych osób.

key: When does it become a crime to murder one of them?
english: When does it become a crime to murder one of them?
polish: Kiedy zabicie jednej z nich staje się przestępstwem?

key: An hour. Seriously, that's a real law we passed. People-replicators are illegal, but if a glitch goes wrong and you have too many yous, you've got an hour to legally kill them.
english: An hour. Seriously, that's a real law we passed. People-replicators are illegal, but if a glitch goes wrong and you have too many yous, you've got an hour to legally kill them.
polish: Po godzinie. Serio, uchwaliliśmy takie prawo. Replikatory ludzi są nielegalne, ale jeśli glitch pójdzie źle i masz za dużo siebie, masz godzinę, żeby legalnie ich zabić.

key: Well, that settles all moral questions here, carry on.
english: Well, that settles all moral questions here, carry on.
polish: No, to rozwiązuje wszystkie dylematy moralne, nie przeszkadzam.

key: Wait, WHICH one can kill the other?
english: Wait, WHICH one can kill the other?
polish: Chwila, KTÓRA może zabić tę drugą?

key: We choose! Like how Offworlders pick what happens to their organs? We can register who gets priority in the event of a glitchdupe: new you or old.
english: We choose! Like how Offworlders pick what happens to their organs? We can register who gets priority in the event of a glitchdupe: new you or old.
polish: Sami wybieramy! Jak ludzie z Offworld, którzy decydują, co się stanie z ich organami. Można zarejestrować, kto ma pierwszeństwo w razie glitchowego duplikatu: nowa wersja ciebie czy stara.

key: No offense but your culture is a horror show.
english: No offense but your culture is a horror show.
polish: Bez urazy, ale wasza kultura to horror.

key: New! I don't like to live in the past, or get murdered by a past self. Which would you want?
english: New! I don't like to live in the past, or get murdered by a past self. Which would you want?
polish: Nową! Nie lubię żyć przeszłością ani dać się zamordować dawnej sobie. A jaki byłby twój wybór?

key: Yes! Kill that crusty old you.
english: Yes! Kill that crusty old you.
polish: Tak! Zabij tę zgredowatą starą wersję siebie.

key: Fine, enjoy having to open DOORS and stuff.
english: Fine, enjoy having to open DOORS and stuff.
polish: Dobra, miłej zabawy z otwieraniem DRZWI i tak dalej.

key: Yes! I'm a Glitcher. I glitch.
english: Yes! I'm a Glitcher. I glitch.

polish: Czemu cię tam już nie ma?

key: How did you guys get here?
english: How did you guys get here?

key: To this nebula, the drift? Teleported.
english: To this nebula, the drift? Teleported.
polish: Do tej mgławicy, do Dryfu? Teleportowaliśmy się.

key: To this arm of the galaxy, thousands of years from home? Also teleported.
english: To this arm of the galaxy, thousands of years from home? Also teleported.
polish: Do tego ramienia galaktyki, tysiące lat od domu? Też teleportacją.
Mamy na tym punkcie lekkiego bzika.

key: Well, it's not my home. But it's about three and a half thousand light years... that way. Meph, where glitch was born.
english: Well, it's not my home. But it's about three and a half thousand light years... that way. Meph, where glitch was born.
polish: No, nie mój dom. Ale jakieś trzy i pół tysiąca lat świetlnych… w tamtą stronę. Meph, kolebka glitcha.

key: They were good at it there, better than us - they could glitch small things big distances, big things small distances...
english: They were good at it there, better than us - they could glitch small things big distances, big things small distances...
polish: Byli w tym dobrzy, lepsi od nas — glitchowali małe rzeczy na duże odległości, duże rzeczy na małe…

key: No they screwed that up dramatically.
english: No they screwed that up dramatically.

key: They tried teleporting a big thing a big distance.
english: They tried teleporting a big thing a big distance.
polish: Spróbowali teleportować dużą rzecz na dużą odległość.

key: Teleported their entire fleet to the other side of the galaxy, leaving their planet defenceless and their fleet stranded.
english: Teleported their entire fleet to the other side of the galaxy, leaving their planet defenceless and their fleet stranded.
polish: Teleportowali całą flotę na drugi koniec galaktyki, zostawiając planetę bez obrony, a flotę na lodzie.

key: The fleet adapted: their short range glitch tech was beyond anything the rest of the galaxy had ever seen, so they could jump in and steal whatever they wanted from passing shipments.
english: The fleet adapted: their short range glitch tech was beyond anything the rest of the galaxy had ever seen, so they could jump in and steal whatever they wanted from passing shipments.
polish: Flota się przystosowała: ich technika glitchowania krótkiego zasięgu przewyższała wszystko, co widziała reszta galaktyki, więc mogli wskakiwać i kraść, co chcieli, z przelatujących transportów.

key: It was the weirdest war. Everyone's terrified of this hyper-advanced fleet, and the hyper-advanced fleet is just like, can we have some food please. Also does anyone want to join. This is boring.
english: It was the weirdest war. Everyone's terrified of this hyper-advanced fleet, and the hyper-advanced fleet is just like, can we have some food please. Also does anyone want to join. This is boring.
polish: To była najdziwniejsza wojna. Wszyscy są przerażeni tą hiperzaawansowaną flotą, a hiperzaawansowana flota na to: czy możemy dostać trochę jedzenia. I czy ktoś chce dołączyć. Nudzi nam się.

key: Why does the hyper advanced fleet talk like a toddler?
english: Why does the hyper advanced fleet talk like a toddler?
polish: Czemu hiperzaawansowana flota mówi jak przedszkolak?

key: I'm summarising a bit. It's a precis. Anyway, it took a decade for them to realise they could never get home, that home could never come for them, and they had nothing left to fight for.
english: I'm summarising a bit. It's a precis. Anyway, it took a decade for them to realise they could never get home, that home could never come for them, and they had nothing left to fight for.
polish: Trochę streszczam. To taki skrót. W każdym razie zajęło im dekadę, zanim zrozumieli, że nigdy nie wrócą do domu, że dom nigdy po nich nie przyjdzie i że nie mają już o co walczyć.

key: They HAD to get new people in, they weren't sustainable. But twenty years later it's a cultural thing, and people like me join, and now we're just the Glitchers.
english: They HAD to get new people in, they weren't sustainable. But twenty years later it's a cultural thing, and people like me join, and now we're just the Glitchers.
polish: MUSIELI przyjmować nowych ludzi, inaczej by wymarli. Ale dwadzieścia lat później to już sprawa kulturowa, dołączają ludzie tacy jak ja i teraz jesteśmy po prostu Glitchers.

key: I didn't! We don't really have a strong concept of membership. Anyone can join, anyone can go off and do their own thing. We survive by welcoming anyone, and no hard feelings if you go and work for someone else for a bit.
english: I didn't! We don't really have a strong concept of membership. Anyone can join, anyone can go off and do their own thing. We survive by welcoming anyone, and no hard feelings if you go and work for someone else for a bit.
polish: Wcale nie odeszłam! U nas nie ma czegoś takiego jak ścisłe członkostwo. Każdy może dołączyć, każdy może odejść i robić swoje. Przetrwaliśmy dzięki temu, że przyjmujemy wszystkich, i nikt się nie obraża, jak ktoś na chwilę pracuje dla innych.

key: So I hear you guys don't like to kill.
english: So I hear you guys don't like to kill.

polish: Czy wy przypadkiem nie torturujecie ludzi?
Czemu nie ma cię już w Offworld?

key: Security. We're trying to keep the peace.
english: Security. We're trying to keep the peace.

key: We've got no interest in the acid, but as the nearest planet this is legally our space, and we won't stand for killing in our space.
english: We've got no interest in the acid, but as the nearest planet this is legally our space, and we won't stand for killing in our space.
polish: Kwas nas nie interesuje, ale jesteśmy najbliższą planetą, więc prawnie to nasza przestrzeń, a w naszej przestrzeni nie będzie zabijania.

key: You don't have some dumb question about Offworld policies?
english: You don't have some dumb question about Offworld policies?
polish: Nie masz jakiegoś głupiego pytania o zasady Offworld?

key: Actually no, it was nothing like that.
english: Actually no, it was nothing like that.
polish: Właściwie nie, to nic z tych rzeczy.

key: I know it's not the right answer here but actually sometimes yes?
english: I know it's not the right answer here but actually sometimes yes?
polish: Wiem, że to nie jest dobra odpowiedź, ale właściwie czasem tak?

key: Then you're probably not going to get far trying to understand Offworld.
english: Then you're probably not going to get far trying to understand Offworld.
polish: To pewnie niewiele zrozumiesz z Offworld.

key: What if it's life or death?
english: What if it's life or death?
polish: A jeśli chodzi o życie lub śmierć?

key: Life isn't yours to take. When you kill someone, you override every choice they were ever going to make, all the good they could ever do. It's an irreversible loss of unknowable magnitude.
english: Life isn't yours to take. When you kill someone, you override every choice they were ever going to make, all the good they could ever do. It's an irreversible loss of unknowable magnitude.
polish: Życie nie jest twoje, żeby je odbierać. Zabijając kogoś, przekreślasz każdy wybór, jakiego miał kiedykolwiek dokonać, całe dobro, jakie mógł zrobić. To nieodwracalna strata o niepoznawalnej skali.

key: But it's OK to break their arms?
english: But it's OK to break their arms?
polish: Ale łamanie rąk jest w porządku?
Zawsze chodzi o życie lub śmierć.

key: OK but what if it's you or them?
english: OK but what if it's you or them?
polish: Dobra, ale jeśli to ty albo oni?

key: OK but what if you don't have any concussive rounds.
english: OK but what if you don't have any concussive rounds.
polish: Dobra, ale jeśli nie masz amunicji ogłuszającej.

key: OK but what if you don't have that.
english: OK but what if you don't have that.
polish: Dobra, ale jeśli nie masz młota.

key: OK but what if they're armoured?
english: OK but what if they're armoured?

key: You don't have line of sight to their hand.
english: You don't have line of sight to their hand.

key: You don't have line of sight to their gun.
english: You don't have line of sight to their gun.

key: Then they can't shoot me and I'm fine.
english: Then they can't shoot me and I'm fine.
polish: To oni nie mogą mnie trafić i nic mi nie jest.

key: Their gun can shoot round corners.
english: Their gun can shoot round corners.

key: Then I couldn't kill them anyway.
english: Then I couldn't kill them anyway.
polish: To i tak nie dałoby się ich zabić.

key: OK your gun can fire round corners but it auto-targets their head.
english: OK your gun can fire round corners but it auto-targets their head.
polish: Dobra, twoja broń strzela zza rogu, ale automatycznie celuje w głowę.

key: I don't know, but you do.
english: I don't know, but you do.

key: This is the worst game I've ever played.
english: This is the worst game I've ever played.

key: So you'd sacrifice your life to avoid taking theirs.
english: So you'd sacrifice your life to avoid taking theirs.
polish: Czyli oddasz życie, żeby nie odebrać go im.

key: OK! You couldn't have said that 15 questions ago?
english: OK! You couldn't have said that 15 questions ago?
polish: No dobra! Nie można było tego powiedzieć 15 pytań temu?

key: But look how contrived that had to get.
english: But look how contrived that had to get.
polish: Ale zobacz, jak bardzo trzeba było to naciągnąć.

key: You offworlders are so obsessed with these kill-or-be-killed dilemmas, but they just don't come up.
english: You offworlders are so obsessed with these kill-or-be-killed dilemmas, but they just don't come up.
polish: Wy, przybysze z zewnątrz, macie obsesję na punkcie dylematów „zabij albo zgiń”, a one po prostu się nie zdarzają.

key: We DO have concussive rounds. They stop you just as fast as bullets.
english: We DO have concussive rounds. They stop you just as fast as bullets.
polish: MAMY amunicję ogłuszającą. Zatrzymuje równie szybko jak kule.

key: The choice that comes up is what you take to a fight, and you people keep choosing to kill.
english: The choice that comes up is what you take to a fight, and you people keep choosing to kill.
polish: Prawdziwy wybór to, z czym idziesz do walki, a wy ciągle wybieracie zabijanie.

key: Honestly, I'm starting to consider it.
english: Honestly, I'm starting to consider it.
polish: Szczerze mówiąc, zaczynam się nad tym zastanawiać.

key: How does that fit with preserving life at all costs?
english: How does that fit with preserving life at all costs?
polish: Jak to się ma do chronienia życia za wszelką cenę?

key: No. I don't know what they smoke where you're from, but it's probably not this.
english: No. I don't know what they smoke where you're from, but it's probably not this.
polish: Nie. Nie wiem, co palą tam, skąd jesteś, ale raczej nie to.

key: You're in a bar and you want to relax less?
english: You're in a bar and you want to relax less?
polish: Siedzisz w barze i chcesz się mniej relaksować?

key: I'm chief of security, I always want to relax less.
english: I'm chief of security, I always want to relax less.
polish: Kieruję ochroną, zawsze chcę się relaksować mniej.

key: You're kind of hardcore, aren't you?
english: You're kind of hardcore, aren't you?

key: I thought you were a bartender.
english: I thought you were a bartender.
polish: To nie ty obsługujesz ten bar?

key: I doubt you can afford it.
english: I doubt you can afford it.

key: I heard you guys torture people.
english: I heard you guys torture people.

key: You're going to find people use that word for whatever they don't condone, but what we all condone is very different.
english: You're going to find people use that word for whatever they don't condone, but what we all condone is very different.
polish: Przekonasz się, że ludzie używają tego słowa na wszystko, czego nie pochwalają, a to, co każdy pochwala, bardzo się różni.

key: And you condone inflicting pain to get information?
english: And you condone inflicting pain to get information?
polish: A wy pochwalacie zadawanie bólu, żeby zdobyć informacje?

key: Life-saving information? Yes. Most cultures do, just to different extents.
english: Life-saving information? Yes. Most cultures do, just to different extents.
polish: Informacje ratujące życie? Tak. Większość kultur to pochwala, tylko w różnym stopniu.

key: Is this gonna be flimsy relativism all the way down or do you actually want to get into this?
english: Is this gonna be flimsy relativism all the way down or do you actually want to get into this?
polish: To będzie tani relatywizm do samego dna, czy naprawdę chcesz o tym pogadać?

key: Yes: we will inflict pain to save a life. Every time. Any amount.
english: Yes: we will inflict pain to save a life. Every time. Any amount.
polish: Tak: zadamy ból, żeby ocalić życie. Za każdym razem. Dowolnie wielki.

key: Then how are you better than your enemies?
english: Then how are you better than your enemies?
polish: To czym jesteście lepsi od swoich wrogów?

key: Torture would be wrong even if it did work.
english: Torture would be wrong even if it did work.
polish: Tortury byłyby złe, nawet gdyby działały.

key: What if you have the wrong person?
english: What if you have the wrong person?

key: We're doing it... I mean I just said this, but we're doing it to save a life.
english: We're doing it... I mean I just said this, but we're doing it to save a life.
polish: Robimy to… przecież właśnie to mówię, robimy to, żeby ocalić życie.

key: We're NOT killing, and ARE saving lives, they ARE killing, and NOT saving lives, AND inflicting pain.
english: We're NOT killing, and ARE saving lives, they ARE killing, and NOT saving lives, AND inflicting pain.
polish: My NIE zabijamy i RATUJEMY życie, oni ZABIJAJĄ, NIE ratują życia, I zadają ból.

key: Is this still a baffling muddle of shades of grey to you?
english: Is this still a baffling muddle of shades of grey to you?
polish: Czy to wciąż dla ciebie niepojęta plątanina odcieni szarości?

key: I just think when you're the good guys, there's a line you don't cross.
english: I just think when you're the good guys, there's a line you don't cross.
polish: Po prostu uważam, że jak jest się tymi dobrymi, są granice, których się nie przekracza.

key: You're right, it's not reliable. No interrogation is.
english: You're right, it's not reliable. No interrogation is.
polish: Masz rację, nie są niezawodne. Żadne przesłuchanie nie jest.

key: You don't use it when you're asking which wire to cut. You use it when you're asking where the bomb is.
english: You don't use it when you're asking which wire to cut. You use it when you're asking where the bomb is.
polish: Nie stosuje się ich, pytając, który kabel przeciąć. Stosuje się je, pytając, gdzie jest bomba.

key: Because pain is worse than death?
english: Because pain is worse than death?
polish: Bo ból jest gorszy od śmierci?

key: All power can be abused. If we give it up for that, we get ruled by abusers.
english: All power can be abused. If we give it up for that, we get ruled by abusers.
polish: Każdej władzy można nadużyć. Jeśli z tego powodu z niej zrezygnujemy, będą nami rządzić ci, co jej nadużywają.

key: We've seen it happen on our world, again and again.
english: We've seen it happen on our world, again and again.
polish: Na naszym świecie widzieliśmy to raz po raz.

key: Sure, but some powers are more serious than others.
english: Sure, but some powers are more serious than others.
polish: Jasne, ale niektóre rodzaje władzy są poważniejsze od innych.

key: Is inflicting pain more serious than killing?
english: Is inflicting pain more serious than killing?
polish: Czy zadawanie bólu jest poważniejsze od zabijania?

key: Then we have the kind of cultural difference a conversation is never going to bridge.
english: Then we have the kind of cultural difference a conversation is never going to bridge.
polish: To mamy różnicę kulturową, której żadna rozmowa nie zasypie.

key: I sound like a monster to you, you sound like a monster to me.
english: I sound like a monster to you, you sound like a monster to me.
polish: Dla ciebie brzmię jak potwór, dla mnie ty brzmisz jak potwór.

key: You don't sound like a monster to me.
english: You don't sound like a monster to me.
polish: Dla mnie nie brzmisz jak potwór.

key: That's what we keep asking cultures who kill. All force is wrong when you're wrong. Ours doesn't leave anyone dead.
english: That's what we keep asking cultures who kill. All force is wrong when you're wrong. Ours doesn't leave anyone dead.
polish: To samo ciągle pytamy kultury, które zabijają. Każda siła jest zła, kiedy się mylisz. Nasza nikogo nie zostawia martwym.

key: But that makes you quicker to use it.
english: But that makes you quicker to use it.
polish: Ale przez to łatwiej wam po nią sięgać.

key: There's a politic answer to this my CO would give to outsiders, about how seriously we take it, but no. It does. We are. I am.
english: There's a politic answer to this my CO would give to outsiders, about how seriously we take it, but no. It does. We are. I am.
polish: Jest na to dyplomatyczna odpowiedź, jaką mój dowódca dałby obcym, o tym, jak poważnie to traktujemy, ale nie. Łatwiej. Nam łatwiej. Mnie łatwiej.

key: I will beat twenty people unconscious if it stops one death.
english: I will beat twenty people unconscious if it stops one death.
polish: Pobiję do nieprzytomności dwadzieścia osób, jeśli to zapobiegnie jednej śmierci.

key: I will break all of your fingers if I think one of them's going to pull a trigger.
english: I will break all of your fingers if I think one of them's going to pull a trigger.
polish: Połamię ci wszystkie palce, jeśli uznam, że któryś z nich pociągnie za spust.

key: Pain ends. Death doesn't. That's the end of it for me, for us. I'm not here to make my culture palatable to you, so if you don't like it finish your drink and leave me the hell alone.
english: Pain ends. Death doesn't. That's the end of it for me, for us. I'm not here to make my culture palatable to you, so if you don't like it finish your drink and leave me the hell alone.
polish: Ból się kończy. Śmierć nie. Dla mnie, dla nas, to zamyka sprawę. Nie jestem tu po to, żeby moja kultura ci smakowała, więc jak ci się nie podoba, dopij drinka i odczep się ode mnie, do cholery.

key: Oh. I thought that was your drink.
english: Oh. I thought that was your drink.

polish: Hej, Mirfak. Jesteś z Sovereign, prawda?

key: Sovereign have a white hair thing going on these days, dunno if you noticed.
english: Sovereign have a white hair thing going on these days, dunno if you noticed.
polish: W Sovereign panuje teraz moda na białe włosy, nie wiem, czy to widać.

key: That's the joke. Welcome to the joke. It's bad here now.
english: That's the joke. Welcome to the joke. It's bad here now.
polish: Na tym polega żart. Witaj w żarcie. Jest tu teraz kiepsko.

key: Is Sovereign a company or a government?
english: Is Sovereign a company or a government?

key: Did you join, or were you kinda born into it?
english: Did you join, or were you kinda born into it?
polish: Wstąpienie było twoim wyborem, czy to raczej kwestia urodzenia?

key: Sovereign seem to kill a lot.
english: Sovereign seem to kill a lot.

key: Same as everyone. They're after the acid.
english: Same as everyone. They're after the acid.
polish: To samo co wszyscy. Chodzi im o kwas.

key: It makes the best batteries in the galaxy, and Sovereign love to have the best thing in the galaxy.
english: It makes the best batteries in the galaxy, and Sovereign love to have the best thing in the galaxy.
polish: Robi się z niego najlepsze baterie w galaktyce, a Sovereign uwielbia mieć najlepsze rzeczy w galaktyce.

key: I signed up, it's all on me (laughs). There's a difference between living on a Sovereign world and actually working for the company - no-one gets in for free.
english: I signed up, it's all on me (laughs). There's a difference between living on a Sovereign world and actually working for the company - no-one gets in for free.
polish: Z własnej woli, to wszystko moja wina (śmiech). Czym innym jest życie na świecie Sovereign, a czym innym praca dla firmy — nikt nie dostaje się tam za darmo.

key: Yep. That's the slogan, right? "If you're good at what you do, you know who we are. If you're the best, you already work here."
english: Yep. That's the slogan, right? "If you're good at what you do, you know who we are. If you're the best, you already work here."
polish: No jasne. Tak brzmi hasło, prawda? „Jeśli jesteś dobry w tym, co robisz, wiesz, kim jesteśmy. Jeśli jesteś najlepszy, już tu pracujesz”.

key: What did you do for them?
english: What did you do for them?
polish: Na czym polegała twoja praca u nich?

key: Encryption. I was a mathematician, figuring out new ways to make comms secure. I made secrets more secret.
english: Encryption. I was a mathematician, figuring out new ways to make comms secure. I made secrets more secret.
polish: Szyfrowanie. Matematyka, nowe sposoby zabezpieczania łączności. Moja praca polegała na tym, żeby tajemnice były jeszcze bardziej tajne.

key: It's a company. For-profit, legally incorporated on every civilised world.
english: It's a company. For-profit, legally incorporated on every civilised world.
polish: To firma. Nastawiona na zysk, zarejestrowana na każdym cywilizowanym świecie.

key: I get why you're asking, though - they're big, right?
english: I get why you're asking, though - they're big, right?
polish: Ale rozumiem, czemu pytasz — są wielcy, co?

key: Most governments get one planet, Sovereign has 35. First company to rank in the galaxy's biggest militaries.
english: Most governments get one planet, Sovereign has 35. First company to rank in the galaxy's biggest militaries.
polish: Większość rządów ma jedną planetę, Sovereign ma 35. Pierwsza firma w czołówce największych armii galaktyki.

key: It's not a government, but it sure makes governments nervous.
english: It's not a government, but it sure makes governments nervous.
polish: To nie rząd, ale rządy przy nim nerwowo się wiercą.

key: (Laughs) Sovereign are... amoral. They make decisions based on profit, and they're brutally efficient.
english: (Laughs) Sovereign are... amoral. They make decisions based on profit, and they're brutally efficient.
polish: (Śmiech) Sovereign jest… amoralne. Decyzje podejmuje dla zysku i jest brutalnie skuteczne.

key: They've done a lot of good, toppled a lot of nasty regimes - most of the worlds they operate were in a real bad place before.
english: They've done a lot of good, toppled a lot of nasty regimes - most of the worlds they operate were in a real bad place before.
polish: Zrobili sporo dobrego, obalili mnóstwo paskudnych reżimów — większość światów, na których działają, była wcześniej w naprawdę złym stanie.

key: But that's just coincidence. They did it because it adds up, and they do a lot of bad things when they add up too.
english: But that's just coincidence. They did it because it adds up, and they do a lot of bad things when they add up too.
polish: Ale to tylko zbieg okoliczności. Zrobili to, bo się opłacało, a kiedy się opłaca, robią też mnóstwo złych rzeczy.

key: Alright, we're getting into my conspiracy theories here, so you've gotta stop me when this gets too dumb for you.
english: Alright, we're getting into my conspiracy theories here, so you've gotta stop me when this gets too dumb for you.
polish: Dobra, wchodzimy w moje teorie spiskowe, więc musisz mnie powstrzymać, jak zrobi się dla ciebie za głupio.

key: Nothing is too dumb for me.
english: Nothing is too dumb for me.
polish: Dla mnie nic nie jest za głupie.

key: This is already too dumb for me.
english: This is already too dumb for me.

key: OK, so who runs Sovereign? Officially, the board of directors.
english: OK, so who runs Sovereign? Officially, the board of directors.
polish: OK, więc kto rządzi Sovereign? Oficjalnie zarząd.

key: But they have to do what the stakeholders want, or they'll be voted off and replaced.
english: But they have to do what the stakeholders want, or they'll be voted off and replaced.
polish: Ale zarząd musi robić to, czego chcą udziałowcy, bo inaczej zostanie odwołany i wymieniony.

key: That's not a theory, that happens all the time.
english: That's not a theory, that happens all the time.
polish: To nie teoria, to się dzieje cały czas.

key: So they have literally no autonomy. They just execute the will of the stakeholders, no matter what.
english: So they have literally no autonomy. They just execute the will of the stakeholders, no matter what.
polish: Czyli zarząd nie ma dosłownie żadnej autonomii. Po prostu wykonuje wolę udziałowców, bez względu na wszystko.

key: So the stakeholders run Sovereign, right?
english: So the stakeholders run Sovereign, right?
polish: Więc to udziałowcy rządzą Sovereign, tak?

key: I sense this is setting me up for a 'wrong'.
english: I sense this is setting me up for a 'wrong'.

key: I saw that coming but didn't want to break your flow.
english: I saw that coming but didn't want to break your flow.
polish: Dało się to przewidzieć, ale szkoda było ci przerywać.

key: Because the people who buy stock in a company only really care about that stock growing.
english: Because the people who buy stock in a company only really care about that stock growing.
polish: Bo ludzi, którzy kupują akcje firmy, obchodzi tylko to, żeby te akcje rosły.

key: There are millions of them, with a million different ideologies and agendas, but when it comes to how the majority votes it's one hundred percent predictable: maximise profit.
english: There are millions of them, with a million different ideologies and agendas, but when it comes to how the majority votes it's one hundred percent predictable: maximise profit.
polish: Są ich miliony, z milionem różnych ideologii i celów, ale to, jak zagłosuje większość, jest w stu procentach przewidywalne: maksymalizuj zysk.

key: This doesn't seem dumb but it also doesn't seem like much of a conspiracy.
english: This doesn't seem dumb but it also doesn't seem like much of a conspiracy.
polish: To nie wydaje się głupie, ale też nie za bardzo wygląda na spisek.

key: The point is, that's not really a human will. There are lots of human wills involved, but in aggregate they act like a machine, or an unthinking force.
english: The point is, that's not really a human will. There are lots of human wills involved, but in aggregate they act like a machine, or an unthinking force.
polish: Chodzi o to, że to nie jest tak naprawdę ludzka wola. Bierze w tym udział mnóstwo ludzkich woli, ale razem działają jak maszyna albo bezmyślna siła.

key: It's just profit, for its own sake, zero other considerations. And that's what effectively runs Sovereign.
english: It's just profit, for its own sake, zero other considerations. And that's what effectively runs Sovereign.
polish: To czysty zysk dla samego zysku, zero innych względów. I to właśnie w praktyce rządzi Sovereign.

key: No one person, not even a group of people, but a cold, unthinking force that emerges from their collective behaviour and the structure they operate in.
english: No one person, not even a group of people, but a cold, unthinking force that emerges from their collective behaviour and the structure they operate in.
polish: Nie jedna osoba, nawet nie grupa ludzi, tylko zimna, bezmyślna siła, która wyłania się z ich zbiorowych zachowań i struktury, w której działają.

key: This wasn't too dumb for me before but it is too dumb for me now.
english: This wasn't too dumb for me before but it is too dumb for me now.
polish: Wcześniej nie było za głupio, ale teraz już jest.

key: And what's scary about that is- I mean that's just scary.
english: And what's scary about that is- I mean that's just scary.
polish: I to, co w tym przerażające, to… znaczy, to po prostu przerażające.

key: But what's scariER is, that means the company doesn't have to act in a way that benefits ANYONE involved in it.
english: But what's scariER is, that means the company doesn't have to act in a way that benefits ANYONE involved in it.
polish: Ale jeszcze bardziej przerażające jest to, że firma wcale nie musi działać na korzyść KOGOKOLWIEK z nią związanego.

key: A director has to order an invasion because she'll be voted out if she doesn't.
english: A director has to order an invasion because she'll be voted out if she doesn't.
polish: Dyrektorka musi zarządzić inwazję, bo inaczej ją odwołają.

key: Her subordinate has to put people he cares about in harms way to get it done.
english: Her subordinate has to put people he cares about in harms way to get it done.
polish: Jej podwładny musi narazić ludzi, na których mu zależy, żeby to wykonać.

key: Those people have to do terrible things.
english: Those people have to do terrible things.
polish: Ci ludzie muszą robić straszne rzeczy.

key: And no-one, no human, wants this to happen. The structure wants it to happen, and the humans have to obey. No-one can afford to lose their job.
english: And no-one, no human, wants this to happen. The structure wants it to happen, and the humans have to obey. No-one can afford to lose their job.
polish: A nikt, żaden człowiek, tego nie chce. Chce tego struktura, a ludzie muszą słuchać. Nikt nie może sobie pozwolić na utratę pracy.

key: They're enslaved by a construct they created, an artificial intelligence that runs on the meat of a trillion human minds.
english: They're enslaved by a construct they created, an artificial intelligence that runs on the meat of a trillion human minds.
polish: Są niewolnikami konstruktu, który sami stworzyli: sztucznej inteligencji działającej na mięsie biliona ludzkich umysłów.

key: Do you have a drinks menu?
english: Do you have a drinks menu?

key: This still isn't dumb enough for me, keep going.
english: This still isn't dumb enough for me, keep going.
polish: Wciąż za mało głupie, dawaj dalej.

key: In fact if you think about it, it's almost the opposite of an AI.
english: In fact if you think about it, it's almost the opposite of an AI.
polish: Właściwie, jak się zastanowić, to prawie przeciwieństwo SI.

key: With an AI, a human provides the goal and the computer is the intelligence that tries to solve for that.
english: With an AI, a human provides the goal and the computer is the intelligence that tries to solve for that.
polish: Przy SI człowiek wyznacza cel, a komputer jest inteligencją, która próbuje go osiągnąć.

key: With Sovereign, the structure has decided the goal and it's using humans as the intelligence to solve for it.
english: With Sovereign, the structure has decided the goal and it's using humans as the intelligence to solve for it.
polish: W Sovereign cel wyznaczyła struktura, a ludzie są inteligencją, której używa, żeby go osiągnąć.

key: It's all the danger of a rogue AI with none of the limitations: humans are brilliant and adaptable minds that can't be foiled by the ways you can outwit a machine.
english: It's all the danger of a rogue AI with none of the limitations: humans are brilliant and adaptable minds that can't be foiled by the ways you can outwit a machine.
polish: To całe niebezpieczeństwo zbuntowanej SI bez żadnych jej ograniczeń: ludzie to błyskotliwe, elastyczne umysły, których nie przechytrzy się sposobami na maszynę.

key: And it's taking over the galaxy.
english: And it's taking over the galaxy.

key: What can we do about it?
english: What can we do about it?

key: Honestly, this right here is helping. The resistance.
english: Honestly, this right here is helping. The resistance.
polish: Szczerze, to, co tu się dzieje, pomaga. Ruch oporu.

key: It'll be a disaster if Sovereign takes Castor's Rest, and they win any straight fleet fight here.
english: It'll be a disaster if Sovereign takes Castor's Rest, and they win any straight fleet fight here.
polish: Jeśli Sovereign zajmie Castor's Rest, będzie katastrofa, a w każdej otwartej bitwie flot tutaj wygrają.

key: Single, rogue infiltrators getting inside their ships and screwing with them, they're not used to that.
english: Single, rogue infiltrators getting inside their ships and screwing with them, they're not used to that.
polish: Pojedynczy, niezależni infiltratorzy, którzy włażą na ich statki i im tam mieszają — do tego nie przywykli.

key: No shortage of parties who'll pay you to screw with Sovereign, so keep screwing with Sovereign.
english: No shortage of parties who'll pay you to screw with Sovereign, so keep screwing with Sovereign.
polish: Nie brakuje chętnych, którzy zapłacą ci za mieszanie szyków Sovereign, więc mieszaj dalej.

key: Yep. Oh boy do they kill a lot. Ask me why I left.
english: Yep. Oh boy do they kill a lot. Ask me why I left.
polish: No jasne. O rany, zabijają na potęgę. Zapytaj, czemu mnie tam już nie ma.

key: No, I don't think I will.
english: No, I don't think I will.

key: They tried to have me killed.
english: They tried to have me killed.

key: Oh, I ran. (Laughs) No cool fight. A friend saw the order come down, she told me, I just bolted.
english: Oh, I ran. (Laughs) No cool fight. A friend saw the order come down, she told me, I just bolted.
polish: A, ucieczka. (Śmiech) Żadnej efektownej walki. Przyjaciółka zobaczyła, że przyszedł rozkaz, dała mi znać, i już mnie nie było.

key: I've seen these people work, it happens FAST.
english: I've seen these people work, it happens FAST.
polish: Wiem, jak ci ludzie działają, to idzie SZYBKO.

key: To date I don't know how close the cleaner was, I just jumped in my pod and never looked back.
english: To date I don't know how close the cleaner was, I just jumped in my pod and never looked back.
polish: Do dziś nie wiem, jak blisko był czyściciel. Kapsuła, gaz do dechy i ani razu za siebie.

key: Sure. Lotta friends. Mostly my folks, still working on getting them out.
english: Sure. Lotta friends. Mostly my folks, still working on getting them out.
polish: Jasne. Masa przyjaciół. Głównie moi starzy, wciąż próbuję ich stamtąd wyciągnąć.

key: But there aren't a lot of great places to go. I'm here in the Rest because it's as far from Sovereign as I could get, but it ain't exactly stable.
english: But there aren't a lot of great places to go. I'm here in the Rest because it's as far from Sovereign as I could get, but it ain't exactly stable.
polish: Ale nie ma za wielu dobrych miejsc, gdzie można uciec. Jestem tu w Rest, bo dalej od Sovereign się nie dało, ale to niezbyt stabilne miejsce.

key: And hey look, they're here too now.
english: And hey look, they're here too now.
polish: I patrz, teraz oni też tu są.

key: They thought I was leaking secrets. I wasn't, but they don't need much to issue a kill order.
english: They thought I was leaking secrets. I wasn't, but they don't need much to issue a kill order.
polish: Myśleli, że wynoszę tajemnice. To nieprawda, ale do wydania rozkazu zabicia wiele im nie trzeba.

key: NOW I am, now I'm leaking that shit to anyone.
english: NOW I am, now I'm leaking that shit to anyone.
polish: TERAZ wynoszę, teraz rozpowiadam to gówno każdemu.

key: You work in encryption, you send things encrypted. If you're good at it, they can't crack it. To them that's suspicious.
english: You work in encryption, you send things encrypted. If you're good at it, they can't crack it. To them that's suspicious.
polish: Pracujesz przy szyfrowaniu, wysyłasz zaszyfrowane rzeczy. Jak robisz to dobrze, nie potrafią tego złamać. Dla nich to podejrzane.

key: I was like: you literally pay me to do this. And they were like- well they didn't say anything, they just sent someone to kill me.
english: I was like: you literally pay me to do this. And they were like- well they didn't say anything, they just sent someone to kill me.
polish: A ja na to: przecież dosłownie płacicie mi za to. A oni na to… no, nic nie powiedzieli, po prostu przysłali kogoś, żeby mnie zabił.

key: PainBurgers are vegan. No real meat in em anymore.
english: PainBurgers are vegan. No real meat in em anymore.
polish: PainBurgery są wegańskie. Nie ma już w nich prawdziwego mięsa.

key: No, I'm just practicing my awkward hovering.
english: No, I'm just practicing my awkward hovering.
polish: Nie, tylko ćwiczę niezręczne sterczenie obok.

key: Probably. Send me the details, I'll put some feelers out.
english: Probably. Send me the details, I'll put some feelers out.
polish: Pewnie tak. Podeślij szczegóły, porozpytuję tu i tam.

key: My fee's <PersonalMissionCost> - I'll start now, but come back when you've got the money and I can start telling you where to look.
english: My fee's <PersonalMissionCost> - I'll start now, but come back when you've got the money and I can start telling you where to look.
polish: Moja stawka to <PersonalMissionCost>. Zaczynam od razu, ale wróć, jak będziesz mieć kasę, to zacznę ci mówić, gdzie szukać.

key: Yeah, sorry to be mercenary, but my people need paying. Intel comes from betrayal, betrayal is expensive.
english: Yeah, sorry to be mercenary, but my people need paying. Intel comes from betrayal, betrayal is expensive.
polish: No, wybacz tę pazerność, ale moim ludziom trzeba płacić. Informacje biorą się ze zdrady, a zdrada jest droga.

key: I forgot that this costs money, I'm leaving now.
english: I forgot that this costs money, I'm leaving now.
polish: Wyleciało mi z głowy, że to kosztuje. Już idę.

key: I thought I did but now I'm not sure what I'm doing.
english: I thought I did but now I'm not sure what I'm doing.
polish: Wydawało mi się, że mam, ale teraz nie wiem, co robię.

key: I changed my mind between coming over here and you asking me that.
english: I changed my mind between coming over here and you asking me that.
polish: Plany zmieniły się gdzieś między podejściem tutaj a twoim pytaniem.

key: Perfect. I found the ship <PersonalMissionTarget> is going to be transported on, and I've got someone in place to dispatch it at my signal. I'll send the details to the jobs board - the security is serious, so read up on it and get your shit together before you say the word.
english: Perfect. I found the ship <PersonalMissionTarget> is going to be transported on, and I've got someone in place to dispatch it at my signal. I'll send the details to the jobs board - the security is serious, so read up on it and get your shit together before you say the word.
polish: Idealnie. Znalazłam statek, na którym przewiozą: <PersonalMissionTarget>, i mam na miejscu kogoś, kto na mój sygnał go wyprawi. Szczegóły dam na tablicę zleceń — zabezpieczenia są poważne, więc poczytaj o nich i weź się w garść, zanim dasz znak.

key: That's good because I'm completely ready for this and not at all terrified.
english: That's good because I'm completely ready for this and not at all terrified.
polish: To dobrze, bo mam pełną gotowość i ani trochę strachu.

key: Oh God, I actually have to do this now, don't I?
english: Oh God, I actually have to do this now, don't I?
polish: O Boże, teraz naprawdę muszę to zrobić, co?

key: Heh. I'd give you a pep talk, but statistically most people who try things like this just die. Good luck, though.
english: Heh. I'd give you a pep talk, but statistically most people who try things like this just die. Good luck, though.
polish: Heh. Dodałabym ci otuchy, ale statystycznie większość ludzi, którzy próbują takich rzeczy, po prostu ginie. Mimo to powodzenia.

key: I still have some personal business.
english: I still have some personal business.

key: Every Stronghold has turned. Every faction is crippled. The Drift is functionally independent.
english: Every Stronghold has turned. Every faction is crippled. The Drift is functionally independent.
polish: Każda twierdza przeszła na naszą stronę. Każda frakcja jest okaleczona. Dryf jest w praktyce niepodległy.

key: There'll still be remnants, and power struggles, and it'll take a while for things to shake out.
english: There'll still be remnants, and power struggles, and it'll take a while for things to shake out.
polish: Zostaną jeszcze niedobitki i walki o władzę, a sprawy trochę potrwają, zanim się ułożą.

key: But you know what's really changed?
english: But you know what's really changed?
polish: Ale wiesz, co naprawdę się zmieniło?

key: Four major galactic powers no longer have access to this wildly precious resource?
english: Four major galactic powers no longer have access to this wildly precious resource?
polish: Cztery wielkie galaktyczne potęgi straciły dostęp do tego szalenie cennego surowca?

key: We're generally not murdering, torturing or imprisoning each other?
english: We're generally not murdering, torturing or imprisoning each other?
polish: Na ogół się nawzajem nie mordujemy, nie torturujemy i nie więzimy?

key: We're not being occupied or kicked out of our homes anymore?
english: We're not being occupied or kicked out of our homes anymore?
polish: Nikt nas już nie okupuje ani nie wyrzuca z domów?

key: OK yeah, it actually has changed a lot. But I was thinking of one thing in particular.
english: OK yeah, it actually has changed a lot. But I was thinking of one thing in particular.
polish: No dobra, faktycznie sporo się zmieniło. Ale miałam na myśli jedną konkretną rzecz.

key: Fleets. Used to have a lot of those. Sovereign, Glitchers, Offworld, Foundry.
english: Fleets. Used to have a lot of those. Sovereign, Glitchers, Offworld, Foundry.
polish: Floty. Kiedyś było ich tu mnóstwo. Sovereign, Glitchers, Offworld, Foundry.

key: They were all pretty strong. Made it hard for anyone new to muscle into this space.
english: They were all pretty strong. Made it hard for anyone new to muscle into this space.
polish: Wszystkie całkiem silne. Przez nie nikt nowy nie mógł się tu wepchnąć.

key: But they're gone now. We took this nebula by subterfuge.
english: But they're gone now. We took this nebula by subterfuge.
polish: Ale już ich nie ma. Wzięliśmy tę mgławicę podstępem.

key: We're a bunch of spies, thieves, killers, and civilians.
english: We're a bunch of spies, thieves, killers, and civilians.
polish: Jesteśmy bandą szpiegów, złodziei, zabójców i cywilów.

key: But not a lot of captains. Not a lot of crew. Very few actual ships.
english: But not a lot of captains. Not a lot of crew. Very few actual ships.
polish: Ale niewielu kapitanów. Niewielu załogantów. Bardzo mało prawdziwych statków.

key: You think we should make a fleet?
english: You think we should make a fleet?

key: If you want to rumble a spy, ask two questions: Who started it? And what was achieved?
english: If you want to rumble a spy, ask two questions: Who started it? And what was achieved?
polish: Jeśli chcesz zdemaskować szpiega, zadaj dwa pytania: kto to zaczął? I co zostało osiągnięte?

key: I started this. And now this nebula has no fleets.
english: I started this. And now this nebula has no fleets.
polish: To ja to zaczęłam. A teraz ta mgławica nie ma flot.

key: I retired from getting shot. Decided to try a less direct approach. And I have this theory:
english: I retired from getting shot. Decided to try a less direct approach. And I have this theory:
polish: Przeszłam na emeryturę od dostawania kulek. Postanowiłam spróbować mniej bezpośredniego podejścia. I mam taką teorię:

key: If you want to start a revolution, all you have to do is convince some unhappy people there already is one.
english: If you want to start a revolution, all you have to do is convince some unhappy people there already is one.
polish: Jeśli chcesz wywołać rewolucję, wystarczy przekonać paru nieszczęśliwych ludzi, że ona już trwa.

key: You guys took it from there. And I only got shot once.
english: You guys took it from there. And I only got shot once.
polish: Dalej to już była wasza robota. A ja dostałam kulkę tylko raz.

key: In a few minutes, a fleet of over a hundred siege ships is going to reach the Drift, take out all our defenses and seize it for my client.
english: In a few minutes, a fleet of over a hundred siege ships is going to reach the Drift, take out all our defenses and seize it for my client.
polish: Za kilka minut flota ponad stu okrętów oblężniczych dotrze do Dryfu, zniszczy całą naszą obronę i przejmie go dla mojego klienta.

key: Are we all about to die?
english: Are we all about to die?

key: Mind if I watch it with you? [Permanently ends this galaxy]
english: Mind if I watch it with you? [Permanently ends this galaxy]
polish: Mogę popatrzeć z tobą? [Trwale kończy tę galaktykę]

key: Not at all. You want a drink?
english: Not at all. You want a drink?

key: My client doesn't like killing and they don't like making enemies.
english: My client doesn't like killing and they don't like making enemies.
polish: Mój klient nie lubi zabijać i nie lubi robić sobie wrogów.

key: The first wave of ships will just shut down defenses. The second wave will be transports.
english: The first wave of ships will just shut down defenses. The second wave will be transports.
polish: Pierwsza fala statków tylko wyłączy obronę. Druga fala to transportowce.

key: You're all going to the nearest interstellar hub with a relocation package generous enough to settle wherever you want.
english: You're all going to the nearest interstellar hub with a relocation package generous enough to settle wherever you want.
polish: Wszyscy polecicie do najbliższego węzła międzygwiezdnego z pakietem przesiedleńczym tak hojnym, że osiądziecie, gdzie tylko zechcecie.

key: My client can afford it if they get a whole nebula of battery acid out of it.
english: My client can afford it if they get a whole nebula of battery acid out of it.
polish: Mojego klienta na to stać, skoro zyska całą mgławicę kwasu akumulatorowego.

key: It'll be presented as an offer, but- take the offer.
english: It'll be presented as an offer, but- take the offer.
polish: Przedstawią to jako ofertę, ale… przyjmijcie ofertę.

key: They won't kill you if you don't, but you won't get to stay and you won't get the money, so.
english: They won't kill you if you don't, but you won't get to stay and you won't get the money, so.
polish: Nie zabiją was, jeśli nie przyjmiecie, ale i tak nie zostaniecie, a pieniędzy nie dostaniecie, więc.

key: It's just that usually when someone explains their plan it's because they're about to kill you.
english: It's just that usually when someone explains their plan it's because they're about to kill you.
polish: Po prostu zwykle, jak ktoś wykłada swój plan, to dlatego, że zaraz cię zabije.

key: Oh, no, sorry. I just wanted to tell someone, I've been sitting on this for MONTHS.
english: Oh, no, sorry. I just wanted to tell someone, I've been sitting on this for MONTHS.
polish: O, nie, przepraszam. Po prostu chciałam komuś powiedzieć, siedzę na tym od MIESIĘCY.

key: A fifth party. Someone with means. Independent.
english: A fifth party. Someone with means. Independent.
polish: Piąta strona. Ktoś z możliwościami. Niezależny.

key: It's a contract. You take contracts. I've taken contracts for forty years. You know what they say about old spies?
english: It's a contract. You take contracts. I've taken contracts for forty years. You know what they say about old spies?
polish: To kontrakt. Ty bierzesz kontrakty. Ja biorę kontrakty od czterdziestu lat. Wiesz, co się mówi o starych szpiegach?
Że są starzy, a do tego szpiegami?

key: Nothing. They're all dead by thirty-six.
english: Nothing. They're all dead by thirty-six.
polish: Nic. Wszyscy giną, zanim skończą trzydzieści sześć lat.

key: You make it to sixty in this job by being very, very, very, careful.
english: You make it to sixty in this job by being very, very, very, careful.
polish: Do sześćdziesiątki w tej robocie dociera się tylko dzięki temu, że jest się bardzo, bardzo, bardzo ostrożnym.

key: And eventually, you get a rep.
english: And eventually, you get a rep.
polish: I w końcu zdobywa się reputację.

key: If you wanna crush an empire in this galaxy, you send an armada.
english: If you wanna crush an empire in this galaxy, you send an armada.
polish: Jeśli chcesz zmiażdżyć imperium w tej galaktyce, wysyłasz armadę.

key: You wanna crush four, you send me.
english: You wanna crush four, you send me.

FOUNDRY
We built this place, bored every station out of cold rock.
When Sovereign ditched us here, we made it home.
Now it's the last good fuel reserve in the quadrant, and everyone wants a slice.
english:

OFFWORLD SECURITY
Offworld law enforcement for Caeli, the closest planet.
We do not kill. We're here to pacify anyone who does.

Nie zabijamy. Jesteśmy tu, żeby spacyfikować każdego, kto zabija.

If you're good at what you do, you know who we are.
